title: HookProbe OS ADR 0020 adversarial-resilience finding
description: One probe outcome, emitted by security/redteam/engine (findings.jsonl, one object per line) and ingested by hookprobe-evidence::ingest_finding into the `findings` node table. See docs/adr/0020-adversarial-resilience-harness.md D6 for the full rationale.

outcome.description: MUST be 'inconclusive' whenever verified_fired=false, regardless of any claim -- the engine's Finding::new and hookprobe-evidence's ingest_finding both re-derive this defensively; a producer's claimed outcome is never trusted over the verified_fired bit.

severity.description: the Gate R threshold class if breached/inconclusive; 'red' + non-withstood blocks Gate R (ADR 0020 D5)

verified_fired.description: did we OBSERVE the DUT's own defense act (read from ITS telemetry, never inferred from the attacker's own success/failure)? false forces outcome=inconclusive.

evidence_ref.description: a DUT-side event/response id or matched log line proving the outcome

mitre_attck.description: optional MITRE ATT&CK technique id, e.g. T1595.001

validates_adr.description: optional ADR number this finding confirms still holds (D6 `validates` edge), e.g. '0018'
